answer: A new identity must deposit a non-transferable bond into a public vault and then serve as a scheduled beacon: once per epoch it publishes a signed measurement of a randomly assigned peer's work, and three disjoint established jurors check that the signature is unique to that operator. Until six clean beacon rounds land, rewards accrue only inside a non-withdrawable oasis. If two identities share an operator key, their beacon signatures collide and both vaults are forfeited, so a farm cannot staff many beacons from one wallet.
